notes: The placement test is harder to fluke. Each rung of the ladder now carries four questions instead of three and needs three of them right, which takes the odds of guessing your way up a rung from about one in six to about one in twenty, while still forgiving a single mis-tap. That meant writing a new fourth question for all seventy rungs across the six courses. Two Spanish rungs were also asking about the conditional and about cuando plus the subjunctive, which that course only teaches at or after the lesson each rung places you at, so both have been moved to where the material is genuinely behind you.
